jobs.title: BMC Remedy ITSM Subject Matter Expert / Platform Architect with Security Clearance
jobs.description:
Job Title: BMC Remedy ITSM Subject Matter Expert / Platform Architect

Organization type: U.S. Department of Defense / federal contractor

Clearance: Active Secret Clearance or Higher

Experience level: Senior / Principal (15–20+ years BMC Remedy ITSM) Position summary

Serve as the primary platform architect and subject matter expert for the BMC Remedy ITSM suite. Design, configure, upgrade, integrate, and operate enterprise Remedy environments spanning Development, QA, and Production. Translate complex business requirements from federal stakeholders into secure, ITIL-aligned Remedy solutions—including custom applications, service request catalogs, CMDB structures, workflows, and enterprise integrations. Key responsibilities

Platform architecture and administration

Own architecture, configuration, and support for Remedy ARS and the ITSM suite, including Service Desk (Incident/Problem), Change Management, Asset Management, Atrium CMDB, Atrium Integrator / Atrium Integration Engine, Service Level Management (SLM/SLA), Knowledge Management (RKM), Service Request Management (SRM), Mid-Tier, Distributed Server Option (DSO), Approval Server, Email Engine, Smart Reporting, SmartIT, MyIT, and Digital Workplace Advanced as used by the customer.
Administer Dev, QA, and Production servers; manage environment setup, promotion paths, and operational health.
Plan and execute major platform upgrades across lifecycle stages (for example, ITSM 9.1.02 to 18.05 and 20.x).
Tune performance and apply upgrade architecture best practices for large federal deployments.Configuration, customization, and data
Configure and import Foundation data, Process data, Transaction data, and CMDB Configuration Item updates.
Develop and maintain service requests in SRM to meet Request Catalog requirements for IT and business users.
Customize out-of-the-box modules by designing and deploying new workflow objects and custom application forms.
Design, configure, and implement Asset Lifecycle solutions aligned with federal security protocols and ITIL practices.
Configure and schedule Smart Reports broadcast to stakeholders for operational and business-intelligence reporting.
Monitor ITSM process performance against Service Level Targets and drive timely delivery.Integrations and automation
Integrate Remedy with enterprise platforms such as Flexera, SharePoint, netTerrain, LDAP/Active Directory, mobile barcode scanning, and network access control tools (e.g., Forescout).
Implement REST API and SOAP web services for ticket transfer and related enterprise interfaces (e.g., authorized service interruption workflows).
Customize Remedy applications and automate ticketing by integrating vulnerability scan results (e.g., ACAS) and certificate-check services.Consulting and delivery
Partner with federal stakeholders to gather requirements and produce technical specifications.
Lead implementations, upgrades, and complex troubleshooting for business-critical Remedy systems.
Support the full project lifecycle: architecture, requirements, design, development, validation, deployment, and post-production support.
Contribute to scoping / level-of-effort estimates and mentor peer engineers on BMC Helix Core / Remedy capability.Required qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
15+ years hands-on BMC Remedy / ARS / ITSM suite consulting, including architecture, customization, upgrades, and multi-environment administration.
Deep working knowledge of CMDB (Atrium), SRM, SLM/SLA, RKM, Mid-Tier, Atrium Integrator, custom workflow development, and Smart Reporting.
Proven experience integrating Remedy via REST, SOAP, LDAP/Active Directory, and common enterprise systems.
Experience operating in federal or DoD environments and aligning Asset Lifecycle / ITSM controls with security and ITIL requirements.
BMC Certified Professional (or equivalent demonstrated mastery) preferred.
Ability to obtain or maintain required clearance (TS/SCI or Public Trust).Preferred qualifications
Prior support of DoD combatant commands, U.S. military services, or Fortune 100 / large federal agencies.
Experience with Digital Workplace, SmartIT, MyIT, Virtual Chat, DSO, and email/approval engine configuration.
Host-platform familiarity with Windows, Linux, and UNIX.
Background mentoring consultants and leading technical capability for BMC Helix Core / Remedy.

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates in the mental health industry, addressing the substantial global challenge of limited access to quality mental healthcare. It provides an agentic behavioral health platform designed to deliver therapy and support to a broad user base, aiming to make therapy accessible and effective for millions.

About the Opportunity:

The DATA ANALYST role is central to enhancing the organization’s behavioral health platform through data-driven insights. This position supports product development and operational strategies by analyzing complex data sets, collaborating across teams, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The role is impactful in shaping decision-making processes and improving user and provider engagement.

Responsibilities:

Develop and refine data visualizations and dashboards to communicate outcomes and engagement trends.
Automate quality reports and network performance monitoring.
Analyze user pathways, business results, and provider network dynamics.
Perform quantitative analyses using SQL and Python.
Provide data-driven insights to support product and network operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate data into actionable strategies.
Present recommendations to senior leadership.
Design and maintain scalable data models and support data ingestion processes.
Analyze platform performance metrics such as model accuracy and user adherence.

Requirements:

3 to 5 years of experience in an analytical role; healthcare data experience a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, and spreadsheet software.
Strong skills in statistics and data manipulation.
Advanced expertise in data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau.
Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.
Familiarity with GenAI tools is advantageous.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Base salary range is $110,000 to $130,000, determined by experience, skills, education, and certifications.

Benefits & Perks:

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Pre-tax benefits including HSA and FSA.
401(k) retirement savings program with matching up to 4%.
Voluntary benefits such as disability and life insurance.
Monthly wellness stipend.
Flexible paid time off and remote work environment.
Regular team events and wellness workshops.
Free access to mental health products for employees and household members, plus discounts for friends and family.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

TalentHop is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.
